reviewer_role: Senior AppSec engineer reviewing junior study material

issues.title: IMDSv2 mechanism underspecified
issues.description: Draft mentions IMDSv2 requires PUT for token but does not explain why this blocks standard SSRF (most primitives only perform GET without custom headers).
issues.recommendation: Detail the PUT token handshake and header requirements vs GET-only SSRF sinks.

issues.title: Missing defense-as-assumption analysis
issues.description: Draft lacks systematic analysis of what assumptions each defense mechanism relies upon and how those assumptions fail.
issues.recommendation: Add structured defense analysis covering IP blocklists, hostname allowlists, DNS validation, and network segmentation.

issues.title: Blind SSRF treatment is shallow
issues.description: Investigation experiments assume full response observability; does not provide rigorous methods for blind SSRF.
issues.recommendation: Model OOB callbacks, timing/error differentials, and internal side-effects for blind SSRF.

issues.title: Missing explicit variants section
issues.description: SSRF has distinct architectural variants (full-response vs blind) that change investigation and impact.
issues.recommendation: Add structured variants distinguishing full-response and blind SSRF.

issues.title: Experiment 2 safety caution
issues.description: Immediately requesting sensitive cloud paths in examples encourages unnecessarily aggressive discovery.
issues.recommendation: Enforce metadata directory listing root (/latest/meta-data/) as safe discovery, reserving credential path for authorized impact demonstration.

issues.title: RFC 3986 claim lacks section specificity
issues.description: RFC 3986 is cited generally without specifying section numbers for URI authority and userinfo parsing.

issues.title: Missing novel scenario and transfer test
issues.description: Topic lacks an unfamiliar transfer scenario and understanding test to prove mechanistic reasoning over payload recall.
issues.recommendation: Include an assessment scenario with non-standard sink (e.g. headless browser rendering to gRPC internal service).

issues.title: Transfer section lacks explicit prerequisite linkage
issues.description: Lists attack surfaces without deducing them from the core concepts (URL parsing, DNS resolution, network boundaries).
issues.recommendation: Add a transferable reasoning model connecting concept primitives to candidate attack surfaces.
